photos.desc: The olm or proteus (Proteus anguinus) is an aquatic salamander in the family Proteidae, the only exclusively cave-dwelling chordate species found in Europe. It lives here!

photos.file: Olm (Proteus anguinus) in Moulis, Ariege (Laboratoire souterraine, CNRS) (33755905584).jpg
photos.desc: This unique amphibian, which Darwin himself cited as an example of organ reduction through disuse, inhabits karstic caves of Central Europe, a very delicate habitat highly sensitive to extrinsic pollu
